gloss_en: Peace within one's own self/bones (שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמָיו) — internal peace between a person's body and soul, the first of the two kinds of peace in Likutey Moharan I:14 (contrasted with peace with the world/others), attained through fear of Heaven and echoing Psalms 38:4 'there is no peace in my bones because of my sin'
